name: zen-stream
description: Zen-Stream — a cinematic movie and TV streaming product (web + Android).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,server -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @zen-stream/web" "npm run dev -w @zen-stream/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @zen-stream/contracts && npm run build -w @zen-stream/web && npm run build -w @zen-stream/server
